en: Sepia-toned landscape view of a small Alpine town nestled in a valley with surrounding hills or mountains. The settlement is composed of clustered houses and a church with a tall bell tower at the center. In the foreground are fields, trees, and a river. At the upper right of the image, printed text reads "Molina di Fiemme, 856 m s. m." indicating the town and its elevation.
